mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome to a journey where the boundaries between sound and existence begin to blur. Have you ever wondered how a simple vibration, a fleeting note, or even a moment of silence can reach far beyond your ears, shaping the very world around you? In Metaphysics of Sound, Nataša Pantović invites us to look at sound not just as something we hear, but as a living bridge—connecting the seen and the unseen, the physical and the spiritual. Together, we'll discover how frequencies, resonance, and even quiet moments carry meaning that can shift our understanding of reality itself. Picture this: every word you speak, every melody you hear, woven into an ancient tapestry that includes myths, science, and the mysteries of consciousness. As we explore how music, language, and spiritual traditions intertwine, you’ll begin to sense how sound can transform your perception, awaken new insights, and deepen your connection with the world. Along the way, ancient wisdom and modern discoveries come together, guiding us through the origins of creation stories and the subtle harmonics that shape both nature and our minds. What if sound isn’t just something we notice, but a force that molds our identity, memory, and sense of belonging? As the layers of meaning reveal themselves, we’ll find that the resonance of sound can be a powerful guide—leading us toward more self-awareness and a richer, more profound relationship with life’s hidden dimensions. So, let’s step into this adventure together, ready to listen, reflect, and uncover the deeper music that’s always been part of us.
